description: Source code implementing the FramebufferMtl class for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, handling framebuffer operations such as clear, invalidate, readPixels, and render pass management.

classes.name: FramebufferMtl
classes.description: Class managing framebuffer operations for Metal renderer, including clearing, invalidation, reading pixels, and render pass setup.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets framebuffer attachments to null.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Resets framebuffer attachments, called during destruction.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards framebuffer attachments, calls invalidate.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates specified attachments.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Unimplemented, intended for partial invalidation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears framebuffer buffers based on mask.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Unimplemented, clears float buffer.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Unimplemented, clears unsigned int buffer.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Unimplemented, clears int buffer.

methods.name: clearBufferfi
methods.description: Unimplemented, clears depth/stencil buffer.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns format of color read attachment.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Returns type of color read attachment.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Reads pixels from framebuffer with clipping and format conversion.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Unimplemented, intended for blitting operations.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks if framebuffer is complete and valid.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes framebuffer state with dirty bits.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Unimplemented, intended to get sample positions.

methods.name: getColorReadRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns current color read render target.

methods.name: getCompleteRenderArea
methods.description: Returns the complete render area rectangle.

methods.name: getRenderPassDesc
methods.description: Returns current render pass description.

methods.name: onStartedDrawingToFrameBuffer
methods.description: Prepares render pass load/store actions when drawing begins.

methods.name: updateColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates cached color render target.

methods.name: updateDepthRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates cached depth render target.

methods.name: updateStencilRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates cached stencil render target.

methods.name: updateCachedRenderTarget
methods.description: Caches the render target for an attachment.

methods.name: prepareRenderPass
methods.description: Prepares render pass description based on current framebuffer state.

methods.name: overrideClearColor
methods.description: Overrides clear color based on texture write mask.

methods.name: clearWithLoadOp
methods.description: Clears attachments using load operation, possibly ending current render pass.

methods.name: clearWithDraw
methods.description: Clears attachments by drawing.

methods.name: clearImpl
methods.description: Performs clear operation, choosing between load or draw method.

methods.name: invalidateImpl
methods.description: Sets store actions to discard specified attachments.

methods.name: getReadPixelArea
methods.description: Calculates read pixel area, flipping Y if needed.

methods.name: readPixelsImpl
methods.description: Reads pixels from a render target, handling format conversion and row copying.
